**Install or update:**

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TymonDomanko/CraftHub/main/install.sh | bash
```

Or download `crafthub-linux-x86_64` below, make it executable (`chmod +x crafthub-linux-x86_64`)
and run it. If you already have Craft Hub, the **Update Craft Hub** button in the bottom-right
corner installs this version for you.

**What's in Craft Hub**

- One-click Install / Update / Uninstall / Open for PhotoCraft, VectorCraft, DesignCraft,
  LightCraft, FilmCraft, EffectCraft, PDFCraft and ArtCraft
- Downloads are verified against each release's `SHA256SUMS.txt`
- Apps with updates are sorted to the top, with an Update all button
- One menu entry per app; leftover entries apps create themselves are cleaned up
- Craft Hub updates itself (button bottom right, next to the version)
- Follows Mint's light/dark appearance setting
- ArtCraft (no Linux release yet) builds from source in a terminal
- Replaces the earlier Python version of Craft Hub and keeps your installed apps

See the commits since the previous release for what changed in this version.
